description: This file defines a class 'Operations' that provides static methods for performing various matrix operations such as addition, direct sum, division, multiplication, and subtraction. Each method takes multiple matrix inputs, converts arrays to Matrix objects if necessary, and utilizes operator classes to perform the calculations, returning the resulting Matrix.

classes.name: Operations
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for various matrix operations, including addition, direct sum, division, multiplication, and subtraction.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Performs matrix addition on multiple matrices or arrays, returning the resulting Matrix.

methods.name: directsum
methods.description: Performs the direct sum of multiple matrices or arrays, resulting in a combined matrix.

methods.name: divideby
methods.description: Performs division of matrices in the order received, using the Division operator.

methods.name: divideinto
methods.description: Performs division where the last matrix divides into the others, reversing the order of operands.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication on multiple matrices or arrays.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Performs subtraction on multiple matrices or arrays.
